name: feat-2893-2d
title: #2893 phase 4 — a search that stops says so, and «המשיכו לחפש» goes on (2-D and complex, port 5180)

cases.title: 2-D: a line whose configuration search stops says so; «המשיכו לחפש» finds the drawing
cases.lookFor: Type the five lines. The last one thinks for about 12 seconds (its own fold ~10 s, then ~2 s of search); the row is added and under the box reads «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.» with «המשיכו לחפש», the figure drawn as it fell. Press «המשיכו לחפש»: in under a second the drawing moves to one where every row holds (the right angle at B, AB = BC), and the sentence is gone.
cases.before: On prod the line thinks for about 10 seconds and draws the rescued figure by itself (measured: 9.9 s, then 0.3 s). Here the search stops after ~2 s and asks; one «המשיכו לחפש» (0.35 s) gives the same drawing.

cases.title: 2-D: a search that finishes and finds nothing keeps today's answer
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: «אין תצורה אחרת — הצורה נקבעה (רק הגודל/המיקום משתנים)» beside the button, as today; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 2-D: the defining interaction builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The square, G on AD, the 37° angle at B; three green rows.

cases.title: complex: a conflicting line is refused naming the earlier line, as today
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with today's sentence naming «z1 = 1 + i»; no «המשיכו לחפש».
